parsed_output.overall_summary: Pete, a startup founder and agency owner, demonstrates how to use 'Skills' within Claude Code to automate complex, repetitive tasks. He specifically shows how he automated monthly investor updates—a process that previously took hours of manual data gathering from Jira and team members—into a two-minute automated task. By creating a skill that includes specific templates and GitHub integration, Claude can generate accurate reports autonomously. Pete encourages other builders to use this feature for consistency in style guides, unit tests, and general productivity.

takeaways.statement: Claude Skills allow users to document a repetitive task once and have the AI execute it perfectly every time.
Automating investor updates using Claude Skills can reduce a three-hour task to just two minutes.

items.name: Install a Claude Skill
items.details: Copy your skill folder into the '.claude/skills' directory within your project. Claude Code will automatically find and use it.

items.name: Automate Investor Updates
